description: This Java source file defines the `StorageClientFragment` class, an Android Fragment that provides functionality for browsing, selecting, and displaying images from device storage using the Storage Access Framework. It includes nested classes and methods for handling file selection, showing images in a dialog, and retrieving file metadata.

classes.name: StorageClientFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that facilitates file browsing, image display, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: StorageClientFragment.ImageDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment class that displays an image from a given URI in an ImageView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, enabling options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, triggering file search.

methods.name: performFileSearch
methods.description: Launches an intent to open the document picker filtered for images.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the file picker, retrieves the URI, and invokes image display.

methods.name: showImage
methods.description: Displays the selected image URI by invoking the ImageDialogFragment.
